news.title: How early-life stress leaves a ‘scar’ inside brain cells
news.summary_en: Researchers at WashU Medicine and Princeton University have uncovered how trauma early in life can leave a lasting effect on the brain and make a person more vulnerable to stress later in life.

news.title: Bantle named vice chancellor for marketing and communications, chief marketing and communications officer
news.summary_en: Amy Bantle has been appointed as WashU’s vice chancellor for marketing and communications and chief marketing and communications officer, announced Chancellor Andrew D. Martin. Her appointment began Aug. 4.

news.title: WashU librarians pick favorite books for National Book Lover’s Day
news.summary_en: In honor of National Book Lover’s Day, celebrated annually on Aug. 9, the Record asked librarians to share some of their favorite titles. The result: a tour de force by a WashU alumna, a sweeping epic of German history and one of the globe’s most beloved fantasy novels. All of these titles are available at Olin Library.

news.title: Platinum powers the future
news.summary_en: Gang Wu at the McKelvey School of Engineering has developed a potential fuel-cell solution for powering data centers or transportation.

news.title: When fear becomes a public health risk
news.summary_en: Researchers at WashU Bursky Public Health explain how trust, misinformation and disrupted care can shape health outcomes during infectious disease outbreaks worldwide.

news.title: Student Affairs is now Division of Student Success
news.summary_en: The Division of Student Affairs is now the Division of Student Success. The name is new, but the mission is not, said Anna Gonzalez, vice chancellor for student success.
